summary: CVE-2026-42616 affecting package ntfs-3g for versions less than 2022.10.3-5
details: In NTFS-3G before 2026.7.7, a heap buffer overflow exists in cat() in ntfscat.c that allows an attacker to corrupt heap memory in the ntfscat binary by crafting a malicious NTFS image. The overflow is triggered by reading a file.
